variants.name: Открытая опора
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. A fictional decorative vehicle prop design for a cheerful stylized 3D mobile game. Create ONE landscape 3:2 concept sheet showing our same graphite fastback muscle car with warm ivory racing stripes, chunky wheels, four round headlights, small hood blower, and the friendly yellow-clad mechanic with goggles standing at the REAR with his stylized harpoon. Reference image 1 is our current car; use the LOWER ROW only for identity. Reference image 2 is its friendly mechanic. Keep the same recognizable car, clean rounded casual 3D game shading, warm sandy desert studio ground. Main car large from elevated front three-quarter view nose toward lower left, smaller TOP-DOWN view at right of exactly the same design. The car is parked, no action. No hood close-up or mechanism diagrams.
Design a DIFFERENT compact original post-apocalyptic SINGLE-BARREL game weapon prop on the hood, aimed forward. Its appearance is fictional and simplified: show external silhouette, surface materials and a low stylized mount only. Keep the prop much smaller than the car and comparable in size to the little blower. No realistic internal mechanisms, no ammunition, no technical or construction information. Retain the roof clear and friendly mechanic on rear deck. The hood prop has one clear barrel and a small rectangular body; no spherical turret dome, giant gun, multiple barrels or tall tower. The main and top-down views must match. No UI, no watermark, no extra words.
Variant 01: an elegant slender single-barrel retro-industrial prop with a small box-like external body on a visibly OPEN low triangular frame, beside the hood blower. Broad simple dark metal surfaces with a few rusty bolts, an airy bracket shape and a modest narrow barrel. Clearly expose the silhouette of the body rather than enclosing it in a dome. This is the leanest open-mount choice. Large label "01" at top-left.

variants.name: Утопленный ствол
variants.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE polished vehicle design concept sheet for a casual mobile idle arcade RPG. This is a NEW concept artwork, not a screenshot edit.
Input image roles:
Image 1 is the current game's graphite muscle car, shown in a before/after montage. Use ONLY the car in the LOWER ROW as the vehicle identity reference. Preserve its recognisable classic Mustang-like fastback shape, graphite paint, two warm ivory racing stripes, chrome bumper, four round front headlights, broad tyres, and small hood supercharger. Ignore all captions, UI, and old gun designs.
Image 2 is the friendly mechanic Quasimodo character reference: preserve his small friendly figure, yellow-brown work clothes, cap, blue goggles and rear-deck harpoon role.
Image 3 is Dane Hallett's Black Avenger alternate concept, used ONLY as inspiration for exposed practical weapon mount language, visible mechanical gun receiver, dark worn metal and compact welded brackets. Do NOT copy its car body, its huge weapon scale, spiked bumper, roof intake or monochrome rendering.
Style: polished CLEAN STYLIZED 3D GAME CONCEPT, rounded bevels, readable forms, broad soft highlights, warm desert sand studio ground and quiet background, slightly weathered gunmetal and a little rusty fastener detail. Match our casual game car; NOT photorealistic, NOT a flat vector illustration.
Composition: landscape 3:2 design sheet. A large complete car shown from a clear elevated FRONT THREE-QUARTER angle, its nose towards the lower-left, with the hood and the entire proposed weapon clearly visible. At the right add a smaller true TOP-DOWN view of THE SAME CAR WITH THE EXACT SAME WEAPON and a close-up of the hood gun underneath. All views must agree. Keep the top-down view readable, not tiny.
Vehicle invariants: retain current car body, paint, stripes, wheels and friendly rear mechanic. Rear harpoon remains stowed toward the rear and must not look like another hood gun. Leave the roof clear.
Primary design task: replace the current tiny round tank-like dome and pipe with a convincing, visibly recognisable compact vehicle firearm. ONE firing barrel and ONE receiver on the HOOD, never a roof turret. The car is the main mass; weapon is an accessory. Gun and mounting together occupy at most roughly one quarter of the hood area; one slim barrel approximately a third of hood length. Gun sits LOW, with a compact receiver, plausible simple brackets, very clear muzzle. Avoid spherical cupolas, toy laser tubes, giant autocannons, miniguns, multiple barrels, tall pedestal, oversized shields, giant spikes, missiles, muzzle fire and game HUD. Show the weapon at rest, aimed forward. A small ammo container or a short visible feed belt may help the weapon read naturally, but keep both restrained.
Text: only the large variant number specified below, top-left. No other words, logos, watermark or long annotations.

Design 02: A compact firearm BUILT INTO a narrow recessed channel in the PASSENGER-SIDE HALF of the hood alongside the blower. The small rectangular receiver is partially inset, with a little exposed top cover and a short feed detail visible in a neat opening. One clearly mechanical slim barrel points forward just above the hood surface. Small rounded rectangular reinforcing rim around the channel. It should feel purpose-built into the car, the LOWEST and cleanest silhouette of the five, yet unmistakably a physical gun with visible receiver and muzzle. No round dome and no large external mounting stand. Large text: "02".
